end.summary:
Practised distinguishing a point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
Answered 1 of 3 attempts unaided correctly.
Identified that a line segment has two endpoints and a ray extends in one direction.
Ray endpoint misconception appeared once and was not corrected after the last time seen.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised telling points, line segments, lines and rays apart using endpoints, arrows and direction. They used a ruler drawing to identify a line segment and a torch beam to explain that a ray starts at one point and continues in one direction. They mixed up whether a ray has one or two endpoints; this was not fully corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to draw a segment with two dots and a ray with one dot and one arrow, then name the endpoints.
